visualRisks.recommendation: Increase the visibility of the waterfront by adding more 'water' tiles or adjusting the layout.

visualRisks.description: House and dock placement may be confusing
visualRisks.recommendation: Ensure that houses and docks are clearly distinguishable from other elements on the map. Consider using different colors for better differentiation.

navigationRisks.description: Route starts abruptly near the edge of the map
navigationRisks.recommendation: Ensure that the route does not start or end too close to the edges, as this can make navigation difficult for players.
Add more landmarks or visual cues along the route to help guide players through the district.
